description: Launch three actual Peer instances with bootstrap membership and existing TestLogDB, persist and apply updates before message delivery, elect node 1 via ticks and drain a current-term no-op. Admit one remote read at node 2 and defer its actual heartbeat replies; admit a second at node 3 and deliver its actual replies, then release all earlier replies. Observe live prefix removal with original status identities and each origin's exported ReadyToRead context.

harness.description: Crash-free Peer-level network using real Handle/ReadIndex/Tick/GetUpdate/Commit and existing in-memory TestLogDB. Only two fixed read contexts and delivery policy are injected.
semantic_changes: No target code or protocol state mutation. Package-local reads observe live registration, term, commit, queue removal and status index.
Memory-backed TestLogDB substitutes durable storage under a no-crash scope; production transport and RSM scheduling replaced by synchronous update processing.
Bootstrap configuration entries are accepted through Peer.ApplyConfigChange; the harness verifies all are Initialize/AddNode. No later configuration change or application command occurs.
Only node 1 clock advances for election; no ticks during finite read-message schedule. All messages are genuine outputs and delivered unchanged, with earlier-context replies delayed then released.
Request contexts are fixed legal distinct nonzero values instead of node random generation; the contract treats them as opaque operation identifiers.

legality.derivation: Launch/bootstrap sources establish fixed initial membership and committed initial configuration. Driver persists each update into TestLogDB before exposing messages, applies committed bootstrap/no-op entries, calls Commit and NotifyRaftLastApplied. This is stricter than the permitted early Replicate send, without excluding overlapping read requests. Peer.Handle supplies sender admission/term protection. All heartbeat replies are produced by actual followers; policy delays early-context replies only. Setup requires elected leader, current-term committed entry, common term/leader and applied prefix. No target goroutines/resources are owned by Peer/TestLogDB; the finite network drains all captured messages before return.
legality.applicability: Only crash-free volatile read identity is measured. TestLogDB durability across failure, RSM client completion and real transport behavior are outside this check.

grounding.derivation: Compare an exported ReadyToRead context to the same origin's independently recorded request context after confirmed prefix removal. There is exactly one request per origin, so scenario+origin identifies it without using the compared context.
grounding.applicability: Both operations use the same preselected policy and are compared; no selection by observed context or outcome.

observable_properties.description: Each successfully confirmed remote operation retains its admitted SystemCtx in the originating Peer readiness result.

uncertainties: This observes the Peer interface, not a NodeHost client timeout or application read.
Memory test storage excludes crash/durable ordering defects; captured response and readiness values are actual implementation outputs.
